traditional: Communication, commerce, and contracts fused with vitality, authority, and recognition. The two act as one and the combined significations are hard to separate.
modern: Identity fused with mind and communication. Self-expression runs through ideas and speech. Only the conjunction is possible, since Mercury never travels far from the Sun. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of thinking and selfhood is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Strong for pitching, writing, and putting your own thinking forward in your own voice.
shadow: Scattered overthinking fused with egotism and needing to be the center, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.

readerCopy.summary: Your thoughts can feel unusually personal when saying what you mean also feels like saying who you are.
readerCopy.body: Your thoughts can feel unusually personal when saying what you mean also feels like saying who you are. When the Sun conjoins Mercury, identity and communication fuse, making it easier to put your ideas forward with confidence and much harder to separate disagreement from criticism of you personally. This can be excellent astrology for writing, pitching, deciding, or having the conversation you have been rehearsing. Just remember that changing your mind does not weaken your position. A better idea is allowed to replace the one you were certain about five minutes ago.
